genius.notes: MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd is the legal issuer identified in both current terms and Mint User Agreement. Restricted Persons provisions apply to holding/using USDm as well as mint services and include persons located, resident or organized in the United States; this is an issuer contractual restriction, not a regulator foreign-exception grant or a blanket statutory prohibition on ownership. USDm is not an equity or fund interest and carries no holder-yield entitlement. Mint-user redemption is into issuer-supported digital assets at intended dollar notional, subject to fees, suspension and proportional reserve-risk terms; no unconditional fiat payout is inferred. Reserve website and live public backing API disclose USDC/USDtb, not a verified monthly CPA attestation. The site attributes GENIUS line of sight to upstream USDtb/Anchorage; it does not authorize MegaUSD (BVI) Ltd or establish that issuer's U.S. intent. No token-specific public GENIUS approval/application/foreign exception or enforcement action was located in the consulted sources. Treasury continues to state the expected January 18, 2027 effective date.

applicabilityBasis.summary: Issuer terms explicitly describe USDm as a stored-value stablecoin intended for payment/transactional use, not a fund share or holder-yield token. Apparent-payment-stablecoin reflects this positioning; eligible mint users redeem into Supported Assets with reserve/pro-rata, fee and suspension limitations, rather than an unconditional fiat obligation. That legal limitation is not treated as GENIUS authorization or a securities exclusion.
